what_it_does: Proposes GPS, a compiler method for mapping computation loops onto Coarse-Grained Reconfigurable Architectures (CGRAs—processors with flexible, reconfigurable functional units). The mapping problem is computationally hard and explodes in size for complex applications. GPS uses two stages: first, Integer Linear Programming (mathematical optimization) constrains the search space; second, Graph Neural Networks learn to identify good mappings and prune unlikely candidates before full optimization runs, speeding up compilation significantly.
